New York Herald, 17 August 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Ship Ann Gray (of St John, NB), Baxter, Leghorn, 65 days,
passed Gibraltar July 8, with marble and rags, to Otto Fab-
bricotti. Aug 3, lat 41, lon 38, spoke brig Oriental, hence for
Cork, 10 days out.
